sourceTitle: Biographical Anecdotes of William Hogarth, With a Catalogue of His Works
description: "Biographical Anecdotes of William Hogarth, With a Catalogue of His Works" by John Nichols is a historical account likely written in the late 18th century. This work offers not only a detailed biography of the renowned English painter and engraver William Hogarth but also includes a systematic catalog of his prints and designs.
